excerpts.label: BS Jobs thesis—AI replaces bloat
excerpts.insight: Logo-aligning consultants at $150K/yr replaceable by AI for fraction of penny. Trade: long bloated orgs with AI intent.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG ACN, MMC, ADP, PAYX. Highest conviction 2026. Cut half workforce = margins explode.

excerpts.label: Advanced packaging = AI bottleneck
excerpts.insight: Chiplets stitched via advanced packaging (CoWoS). This is THE bottleneck for all AI chips—Nvidia, TPUs, custom ASICs.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG AMKR, BESI, SNPS. Agnostic to chip designer. Packaging capacity = AI scaling.

excerpts.label: PTSD—capital discipline premium
excerpts.insight: Post-traumatic supply disorder: GE Vernova targeting 20% margins (from 14%) because they refuse to build capacity despite 2x demand.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG GEV, FSLR, SQM. Screen: oligopoly + demand surge + prior trauma + discipline.

excerpts.label: AI golden age—Uber moment
excerpts.insight: AI is subsidized like early Uber. Use it now before monetization. Derive most value for least cost while it lasts.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STAY LONG real AI. OpenAI raising = party continues. Exit if can't raise.

excerpts.label: Depreciation = bull for Nvidia
excerpts.insight: Bear argument on depreciation is bull case for Nvidia and AI progress. Chips obsolete in 18mo = scaling laws work.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Don't conflate hyperscaler bear with Nvidia bear. Depreciation concern = AI progress validated.

excerpts.label: Inference moves on-device
excerpts.insight: Cloud round-trip 800ms vs on-device 200ms. Agentic AI requires real-time. Memory efficiency breakthrough = device wins.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG MediaTek, Qualcomm. SHORT Lenovo, Dell, Nintendo (41% BOM is RAM).
